notes.title: New character Captain Woody and fancy effects!
notes.notes: With today's update, you get a new character [b]Captain Woody[/b] that can be unlocked with wood. Also, a little work has been done on the [b]effects[/b].

notes.title: v1.0.3 out now! Buy Skins and more languages!
notes.notes:
Update v1.0.3 is now live! 

You can now
- buy more skins (more will come soon!)
- switch to other languages: German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and Japanese
